risk.rationale: All suspicious signals are explained away by verified counter-evidence. The confirmed off-baseline Turkcell sign-in (F2, 0.75) is a non-interactive ExchangeSync/15 mail-sync token, not an interactive logon by the person. The Portugal sign-ins (F5, 0.5) use the university VPN vpn-edge-02 from known device LT-3104. Impossible travel, password-spray (shared egress IP with 201+ MFA accounts in 30 days), and VPN-appliance KEV exposure claims are rejected: firmware 22.7R2.8 includes the cited fixes. No confirmed account-takeover chain, no unresolved exposure, and no weak unexplained signal remains.
